english.title: Board a train in non compulsory ticket area without a valid ticket on the London regional transport railway network
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), whilst not in a designated compulsory ticket area, entered a train on the Transport for London regional railway network for the purpose of travelling without having with you a valid ticket entitling you to travel
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 18(1) and 23 of the Transport for London Railway Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 22 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 24 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 25 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See byelaw 26 in relation to notices displayed.
(v) See byelaw 27 for the liability of authorised person acting in the course of his duties.
(vi) Byelaw 16(5) provides that if a person in charge of an animal breaches any of Byelaws 16(1) to 16(4), then that person:
(a) may be asked by an authorised person to remove that animal, and if he fails to do so immediately, then that animal may be removed by or under the direction of an authorised person;
(b) shall be liable to the Operator for the cost incurred by or on behalf of the Operator in removing and keeping it; and (c) shall be liable to the Operator for the cost of putting any property soiled or damaged back into its proper condition.
(vii) Byelaw 18(3) provides that no person shall be in breach of Byelaw 18(1) or 18(2) if:
(a) there were no facilities in working order for the issue or validation of any ticket at the time when, and the station where, he began his journey;
(b) there was a notice at the station where he began his journey permitting journeys to be started without a valid ticket; or
(c) the Operator or an authorised person gave him permission to travel without a valid ticket.
